sections.st: Ophthalmic Packaging Manufacturer India — IOL Trays, Cataract Kit Packaging, Cleanroom Class 8 · Vapi
leads: Trizen Packaging manufactures ophthalmic packaging from our Cleanroom Class 8, GMP-compliant, ISO 9001:2015 certified facility in Vapi, Gujarat — custom PETG thermoformed packaging for intraocular lenses (IOLs), cataract surgical instrument kits, vitreoretinal surgical instrument trays, and ophthalmic device packaging. Ophthalmic packaging manufacturer from Vapi for ophthalmic device companies and eye care surgical instrument manufacturers across India and for export.

Ophthalmic device packaging requires the most stringent particulate control of any medical packaging category — intraocular lenses (IOLs) are implanted directly into the eye, where any particulate contamination from the packaging can cause endophthalmitis (intraocular infection), a vision-threatening complication. IOL packaging components must be produced in the cleanest possible controlled environment, from the purest available thermoforming materials, with the tightest possible dimensional consistency.

strips.title: IOL Optic Surface Contact — Particulate or Scratch on Optic Causes Rejection
strips.desc: Problem: IOL packaging where the cavity contacts the optical surface of the intraocular lens creates either surface scratches or particulate deposition on the optic — both cause surgical rejection of the IOL. Solution: IOL optic and haptic geometry confirmed from device technical drawing before cavity design. Optic surface suspended in clearance — no cavity contact on the optical zone.

strips.title: Particulate Level — IOL Packaging Requires Highest Possible Cleanroom Standard
strips.desc: Problem: IOL packaging produced outside cleanroom conditions at the cleanest possible standard carries surface particulates that deposit on the IOL optic when the package is opened for surgery. Solution: Cleanroom Class 8 for all IOL packaging component production at Vapi.

strips.title: Micro-Instrument Precision — Vitreoretinal Instruments Have Sub-Millimetre Geometry
strips.desc: Problem: Vitreoretinal surgical instruments (25G, 27G gauge cannulas, micro-forceps) have sub-millimetre geometric features that must be protected from any mechanical contact. Solution: Micro-instrument cavity design from device technical drawing — instrument working end suspended in clearance with minimum 2mm clearance on all dimensions.

strips.title: IOL Optic Clearance — No Cavity Contact on Optical Surface
strips.desc: IOL optic and haptic geometry confirmed from device technical drawing. Cavity designed with defined clearance zone over the optic surface — no packaging contact with the optical zone of the IOL under any handling condition.

strips.title: Class 8 Cleanroom — Highest Particulate Control for IOL Packaging
strips.desc: All IOL packaging component production in Cleanroom Class 8. GMP batch documentation per run. Material CoA confirming medical-grade PETG particulate specification.

strips.title: Cataract Surgical Instrument Kit Sequence — Surgeon-Ready Organisation
strips.desc: Cataract surgical instrument kit tray organised in surgical sequence — instruments arranged in the order of use for the cataract procedure. Confirmed from ophthalmic surgeon/device manufacturer kit specification.

strips.title: EO Sterilization Compatibility — Medical-Grade PETG Standard
strips.desc: Medical-grade PETG for all ophthalmic packaging. EO and gamma compatible. Material CoA per batch.

Cleanroom Class 8, GMP, ISO 9001:2015. Ophthalmic packaging manufacturer from Vapi, Gujarat.

faqs.q: What certifications does Trizen have for Ophthalmic Packaging?
faqs.a: ISO 9001:2015, GMP, and Cleanroom Class 8 (ISO 14644-1 — 100,000 particles/m³). All medical packaging components produced in the Class 8 cleanroom with full GMP batch documentation per production batch.

faqs.q: Is PETG compatible with EO sterilization for ophthalmic packaging?
faqs.a: Yes — medical-grade PETG is compatible with Ethylene Oxide (EO) sterilization and gamma radiation sterilization. EO compatibility confirmed by material CoA per production batch.

faqs.q: What documentation is provided for medical device supplier qualification?
faqs.a: First article inspection report, dimensional inspection records per production batch, material CoA with medical-grade PETG specification per batch, batch records, ISO 9001:2015 certificate, GMP compliance documentation.

faqs.q: Why source ophthalmic packaging from Vapi, Gujarat?
faqs.a: Ophthalmic packaging manufacturer Vapi — Cleanroom Class 8, GMP, ISO 9001:2015. Ophthalmic packaging manufacturer Gujarat for medical device companies. Medical packaging manufacturer from India for domestic and export medical device markets.

faqs.q: What is Trizen's scope for medical packaging?
faqs.a: Trizen manufactures the thermoformed PETG packaging component — the tray or blister shell. Device loading, Tyvek/foil lidding, heat sealing, and sterilization are performed by the medical device manufacturer. Clear scope for DHF traceability.
First article: 14 to 21 business days from device technical drawing or sample — cleanroom CNC tooling at Vapi. ISO 9001:2015, GMP, and Cleanroom Class 8 documentation per production batch.
